name: Tin Street Massacre
description: The mass chaos incident at Tin Street Market that led to Baas's arrest.

timeline.summary: Hiding in a nook, Bozak overhears the lich telling Boros soldiers that he planted a devouring angel mushroom on Vraska's gown to frame her for the Tin Street massacre.
timeline.quote: Boros will have no choice but to charge Vraska with murder.

timeline.summary: Baas reveals she was arrested at Tin Street Market and abandoned by Daeska, and why she avoids the front line.
timeline.quote: I got arrested. Daeska got away.

pages_say.description: A massacre caused by devouring angel spores, for which Gruul raiders were arrested; the lich plans to pin it on Vraska.
The mass chaos incident at Tin Street Market that led to Baas's arrest.
